evidence_quotes: I used double the noodles and mozzarella cheese.

benefit.description: Doubling the pasta and mozzarella may make the dish more substantial and cheesier.

evidence_quotes: I also used cottage cheese instead of ricotta.

benefit.description: Cottage cheese offers an alternative creamy cheese mixture.

edits.replacement_text: In a bowl, combine cottage cheese, 1 cup mozzarella, Parmesan and beaten egg. Stir until well combined.

evidence_quotes: I layered pasta/cheese mix/sauce/pasta/cheese mix/sauce/pasta/sauce/mozz cheese.

benefit.description: The additional pasta and sauce layers may distribute the components more evenly through the dish.

edits.replacement_text: In the prepared dish layer pasta, cheese mixture and sauce; repeat, then layer the remaining pasta and sauce. Top with remaining mozzarella.
